==Polish==

===Etymology===
{{dercat|pl|zlw-opl|sla-pro}}
{{lit|good day}}. The original, now dated, form was {{m|pl|dobry dzień}} (which see for more), which at some point began to be pronounced as {{m|pl|dobrydzień}} (now dated and dialectal) with the stress on ''-bry-''; to prevent the spread of that rural form, the words were rearranged. {{rfv-etym|pl}}

===Pronunciation===
{{pl-pr|a=Pl-dzień dobry.ogg;Pl-dzień dobry-2.ogg;Pl-dzień dobry-3.oga}}

===Interjection===
{{head|pl|interjection}}

# {{lb|pl|idiom}} [[good day]], [[good morning]], [[good afternoon]]
#: {{cot|pl|dobranoc|dobry wieczór}}
